description.value:
A Medtech's Pharmaceutical: Medtech 6+ to know it, DV15 Medical Tech and 500eb of materials a dose. Restores 1d6 Humanity, up to your therapy maximum, for two weeks (stress may end it early). One dose per two weeks; it doesn't mix with Immunoblockers either way. Therapy for a dosed patient gets +2 to the Medical Tech Check (a failed Check wastes it until the next dose).

Cost: Medtech-made: DV15 Medical Tech and 500eb of materials per dose

Item Compendium (2070) • Drugs
